# A method called through the `#id` of a node a reactive `if` holds has no one
# instance to reach on a target that builds the node at run time, and the
# refusal says so. Rendered twice, the component's own body still held the
# call when the inliner asked which copy it meant, and the build was refused
# as a node rendered more than once, though the component was spliced into
# each place and its own body was dropped after.
! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out p.sngl
stderr 'calls a method of the node `#ask`, which this target does not splice where it is written'
! stderr 'rendered more than once'

# bubbletea keeps a run-time instance's state where a call reaches it.
sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go -o tea p.sngl

# A component whose body calls a method of its own node, spliced twice, gives
# each copy its own `#ask`, or both calls name one node rendered twice.
# twice.sngl's constant props once let the optimizer splice it, both copies
# holding the node's one handle; such a body is now the lowering's to splice.
# named.sngl is spliced by passInlinePure, which gave each copy a handle of its
# own but not the one a wrapper of passImplicitState holds for the query it
# moved (Wraps).
sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o twice twice.sngl
sngl generate --platform html --lang go -o twice-html twice.sngl
sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o named named.sngl

-- p.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func look(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=k.length()}
}

component page(name string) ui.node {
    var got option[int] = null
    var on = true

    if on {
        async.query #ask(on=name, fetch=look, :value=got)
        ui.button #again(text="Again", @click { ask.refresh() })
    }
}

component both ui.node {
    page(name="a")
    page(name="bb")
}

ui.window {
    both
}

-- twice.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func look(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=k.length()}
}

component asked(on string, :value option[int] = null) ui.node {
    async.query #ask(on=on, fetch=look, :value=value)
    ui.button #again(text="Again {on}", @click { ask.refresh() })
}

component both ui.node {
    var n option[int] = null
    var m option[int] = null

    asked(on="a", :value=n)
    asked(on="bb", :value=m)
}

ui.window {
    both
}

-- named.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func look(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[int] {
    return {ok=k.length()}
}

component asked(on string, :value option[int] = null) ui.node {
    async.query #ask(on=on, fetch=look, :value=value)
    ui.button #again(text="Again {on}", @click { ask.refresh() })
}

component both ui.node {
    var n option[int] = null
    var m option[int] = null

    asked #first(on="a", :value=n)
    asked #second(on="bb", :value=m)
}

ui.window {
    both
}
